fusions.name: Off the Leash
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and bite for 12 damage, leaving it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Warning Hiss
fusions.desc: You hiss and snap through a cone 3 tiles ahead, dealing 3 damage with a 30% chance to leave each enemy [Damped] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Clutch Warden
fusions.desc: A challenge that pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Faithful Hatchling
fusions.desc: A hatchling follows you and fights beside you, biting for 4 damage every 1.2 seconds. Anything it bites moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
